issues.issue: Receipt date states 'March 21, 2008' but first_cycle_approval.detail and the ACM timeline reference 'March 20, 2008 - NDA submission'; the citation says dated March 20, 2008, received March 21, 2008 — the received date is correct but there is an internal inconsistency with first_cycle_approval which calls March 20 the submission/receipt date.

Orphan drug marked present=true, but the citation only states the sponsor 'previously obtained Orphan Drug designation for I-123 iobenguane sulfate' (a different/prior substance context used to explain PREA inapplicability); it is not clearly a grant of orphan designation for this AdreView NDA approval.

The number '251 patients' appears in key_safety text; it is supported by the citation, but the phrase 'most common adverse reactions ... each occurred in <1% of patients' slightly overstates the quote which says the listed reactions collectively 'occurred in <1% of patients' (not necessarily each individually).

Result text references 'three blinded readers' and sensitivity/specificity point estimates that are all supported by citations; no uncited numbers, but note the prespecified criterion is correctly described as not met, consistent with the reviewer comment.
